## ✅ Contributor Checklist

Please confirm the following checks before requesting review:

- [ ] My file is placed in `posts/` and uses **lowercase kebab-case** (e.g., `posts/git-rebase-guide.mdx`).
- [ ] Frontmatter includes all required fields: `title`, `description`, `date` (YYYY-MM-DD), and `category`.
- [ ] I have run `npm run validate` locally and it completed with **0 errors**.
- [ ] The article contains informative, original content and adheres to community standards.
- [ ] No secrets, private credentials, or `.env` files are committed.
- [ ] I agree that this contribution is submitted under the repository's MIT License.
